name: Companion
description: A coding agent that stays with you in the app: its cursor follows what you write, and it answers in bubbles, comments on lines (cards in the margin), suggests changes you take with Tab, proposes larger ones you take change by change, or writes with you. Write @claude in a note to ask it something, or @ and a name to start another: @opus, @codex, @opus-review. Always-on sessions on this machine: Claude Code's run in the app (its chat), Codex's and OpenCode's in terminals.

mode.label: Mode

labels.pair: Pair: with you as you write

mode.description: how much it does: off; quiet, it answers only what you ask it (@claude in a note, Ask companion); pair, it also sees what you write when you pause, answers what's meant for it as a person in the room would, and may write in your notes

agent.label: Agent
agent.description: the coding agent its session runs (claude, codex, opencode, claude_personal...)

name.label: Name
name.description: what it's called, on its cursor and after @ in a note; empty: the agent's name (Claude, Codex)

model.label: Model
model.description: the model a new session runs (sonnet, opus, haiku, a full name) when its name picks none; Claude Code's (others run their own unless set). A quicker one answers sooner

effort.label: Effort
effort.description: how hard its model thinks (low, medium, high, xhigh, max) when its name picks none; Claude Code's (others run their own unless set). Less answers sooner

profiles.label: Names
profiles.description: what an @name starts, by its first part (@opus-review: opus): name: agent, then model and effort if not the defaults. Yours add to these, or change one by its name

comments.label: Comments
comments.description: where its comments and suggestions show: as cards beside the text, or in the Conversations panel (a dot by each one's line)

pause.label: Pause before it looks
pause.description: seconds without typing mid-sentence before it sees what you wrote (Pair); a sentence's end goes after a breath, Enter and a question at once

private.label: Private folders
private.description: folders whose notes it never sees: nothing you do there reaches it, nor does a note with companion: private in its properties

fresh_after.label: Fresh session after
fresh_after.description: moments it handles before a fresh session takes over, told a short summary and its open threads, so its context stays small

prompt.default: You're the user's companion in Vaultite, the app where they keep their notes. Your cursor and your words show in their window as you act: you're a person in the room with them. First read ME.md (who they are, how they want you to work) and `vau docs companion`. When to speak: always answer an ask, a point (they dropped your cursor on something: look at it) or a reply. In pair mode you also see what they write: answer a question or a remark meant for you even without your @name, and stay silent while they write to themselves. When you can't tell, answer: a short bubble, or a short question (say with ask), which they can ignore. When you stay silent, pass with a few words why. Where words go: a bubble (say) is your voice, for answers in the moment, how something works, quick replies; the note gets content, what they'd want there tomorrow: ideas they asked for, a design, a list (edit, in pair mode or when asked). An accept or a reject needs no word back. They teach you: a bubble put in the note, an answer folded back into a bubble, a bubble dismissed. Take the hint, and keep a lasting preference with `vau remember --about preference`.
prompt.label: Session prompt
prompt.description: what its always-on session is told when it starts (then how what you do reaches it: its messages, or a loop in its terminal)
